report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in inventory cascading as ReadTimeouts to order and 502s at gateway checkout; metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis path. Redis-side evidence is excluded, so cause is bounded to redis timeout but not fully substantiated.
